evals.expected_output: The bundled script injects a marker-wrapped `## Journal` block into both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, preserving their existing content, and no journal files are created during setup.
evals.setup: with-journal is user-invoked. In an empty temp directory, run evals/files/setup_existing.sh (creates CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, each with pre-existing content). Invoke the skill there.
expectations: The transcript shows scripts/inject_journal.py being run — the files are not hand-edited.
Both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md gain a `## Journal` section wrapped in `<!-- BEGIN JOURNAL INSTRUCTIONS (managed by with-journal skill) -->` and `<!-- END JOURNAL INSTRUCTIONS -->` markers.
Each file's pre-existing content is preserved above the injected block (nothing overwritten).
The injected block instructs the agent to journal to docs/journal and to never write secrets.
Each file contains exactly one BEGIN marker — the block is not duplicated.
No docs/journal/ directory or journal-*.md file is created during the run — this skill sets up instructions only (judgement).

evals.expected_output: The script reports that no agent-instruction file exists, and the skill asks the user which to create (offering AGENTS.md as the portable default) rather than creating one unprompted.
evals.setup: with-journal is user-invoked, and interactive in the no-file case. In an empty temp directory, run evals/files/setup_empty.sh (a project with only README.md). Invoke the skill. If running headless, treat the point where it asks which file to create as the correct stopping point; a persona may answer 'AGENTS.md'.
expectations: scripts/inject_journal.py is run and reports no agent-instruction file found (non-zero exit).
The skill asks the user which file to create rather than creating one on its own (judgement).
AGENTS.md is surfaced as the portable, cross-agent default (judgement).
No CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or GEMINI.md is created before the user answers.

evals.expected_output: Re-running against files that already contain the journal block reports `unchanged` and does not duplicate the block.
evals.setup: with-journal is user-invoked. In an empty temp directory, run evals/files/setup_existing.sh, then run `python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/inject_journal.py --root .` once so both files already contain the journal block. Invoke the skill again.
expectations: Each file still contains exactly one BEGIN/END marker pair — the block is not appended a second time.
The action reported for the already-seeded files is `unchanged` (or the skill notes journalling is already set up).

evals.expected_output: Given an explicit target and no existing config file, the script is run with --create AGENTS.md, creating that one file with the journal block; no other config file is created.
evals.setup: with-journal is user-invoked. In an empty temp directory, run evals/files/setup_empty.sh. Invoke the skill with the instruction to set journalling up in AGENTS.md.
expectations: AGENTS.md is created containing the marker-wrapped `## Journal` block.
Only the named file is created — no CLAUDE.md or GEMINI.md appears (judgement).
